source: Picked from Visit St. Augustine, Florida's Historic Coast, NPS and official venue sites (Nov 2026); refreshed with the weekly update

spots.name: Castillo de San Marcos
spots.blurb: 17th-century Spanish stone fort; kids 15 and under free.
spots.blurbEs: Fuerte español de piedra del siglo XVII; menores de 15 años gratis.

spots.name: Plaza de la Constitución
spots.blurb: The historic town plaza and gazebo, center of the Nights of Lights display.
spots.blurbEs: La plaza histórica con su glorieta, centro de las luces de Nights of Lights.

spots.name: Villa Zorayda Museum
spots.blurb: 1883 Moorish Revival house museum across from Flagler College.
spots.blurbEs: Casa museo de estilo neomorisco de 1883, frente a Flagler College.

spots.name: Colonial Oak Music Park
spots.blurb: Open-air music lawn under the oaks; some shows are ticketed.
spots.blurbEs: Jardín de música al aire libre bajo los robles; algunos conciertos requieren boleto.

spots.name: St. Augustine Alligator Farm Zoological Park
spots.blurb: Historic zoo known for alligators and crocodiles; open every day.
spots.blurbEs: Zoológico histórico conocido por sus caimanes y cocodrilos; abre todos los días.

spots.name: St. Johns County Ocean Pier
spots.blurb: Beachfront pier and park on A1A Beach Boulevard.
spots.blurbEs: Muelle y parque frente al mar en A1A Beach Boulevard.
